title: EnsLoss: Stochastic Calibrated Loss Ensembles for Preventing Overfitting in Classification
reviewed_version: publisher proceedings version at retrieval; immutable local SHA-256
inspection_outcome: One Major theory-to-algorithm defect and two Minor bounded findings
summary: Default rank-based gradients cannot be unbiased gradients of the stated independent-loss risk. The expected batch potential admits a noncalibrating minimizing sequence. The abstract mixture theorem survives. The optional Box-Cox formula and current-release tie handling have localized defects.
limitations: No author code execution or empirical rerun.
No immutable historical run/commit/table correspondence established.
Online W&B run histories not fetched.
Not certifying every auxiliary Appendix D statement.

problems.title: Rank-based update does not optimize the claimed independent-loss ensemble risk
problems.outcome: Demonstrated invalid core derivation and objective-level calibration counterexample
problems.location: Algorithm 1 p.5; Equations 5-6 p.6; consistency p.7; Appendix C pp.15-18
problems.assumptions: B=n=2, x=e1,e2, y=+1,+1, linear predictor, default lambda0 lognormal, distinct margins below 1.
problems.check: theta1=0, theta2=+/-1/2 yields expected gradient1 -1.2534402453 versus -0.3952810254; fixed separable risk derivative cannot depend on theta2.
problems.result: Independent-loss gradient identification is false. F(t,-1)=a-b log(t)/2 tends to -infinity while risk stays 1/2 and Bayes risk is 0.
problems.counterevidence: Fixed-law Theorem 3.6 valid; finite-point BCC interpolation possible; no universal SGD trajectory failure or benchmark failure claimed.
problems.correction: No complete consistency repair established; predeclared independent BCC sampling changes algorithm. p>1 does not fix below-threshold rank dependence.

problems.title: Nonzero-lambda inverse Box-Cox generator has zero or nonfinite outputs
problems.location: Equation 4 and Algorithm 2 p.6; Appendix A p.13
problems.assumptions: Untruncated standard normal; lambda1 or lambda-1.
problems.check: lambda1, Z<=-1 gives 0; all-negative-margin batch can have zero derivatives. lambda-1, Z>=1 gives 0^-1.
problems.result: Generator does not always give finite strictly positive magnitudes.
problems.counterevidence: Default lambda0 valid; code clipping and epsilon alter these events; no default empirical failure claimed.
problems.impact: Local general generator and diversity claim.
problems.correction: Domain or truncation revision requires explicit distribution and moment checks; not implemented.

problems.title: Current release assigns unequal derivatives to equal margins
problems.location: losses.py lines 45-48,57; Lemma 3.3 and Algorithm 1 footnote p.5
problems.assumptions: Two zero margins and default clipped lognormal draws.
problems.check: Unequal coefficients at zero occur with probability 3/4; one calibrated loss differentiable at zero cannot provide both.
problems.result: Printed tie merge rule absent in release.
problems.counterevidence: Paper gives correct tie handling; historical occurrence and benchmark impact unknown.
problems.correction: Group equal margins, sample once per distinct margin and duplicate; analytically restores equality only.

repair_verification: Independent analytic counterexamples; no complete repair of algorithm consistency claimed. Local tie-equality repair proved without author-code modification.
